name: DL241 dual auto compressor / expander / limiter
source: Drawmer DL241 product page and operator manual
notes: 1RU, 482 x 44 x 200 mm deep, 3.2 kg, 9 VA (115/230 V selector, fused IEC inlet). Two channels of auto compressor, expander/gate and peak limiter with gain reduction and output meters, stereo link, hard-wire bypass per channel, rear +4 dBu / -10 dBV switch per channel. Balanced I/O. Also built with 6.3 mm jack I/O instead of XLR: check which version you have.
